F. Scott Fitzgerald’s original novel devotes a highly specific, famous paragraph to describing Jay Gatsby’s expression, noting it possessed a “quality of eternal reassurance” that “believed in you as you would like to believe in yourself.” Knowing the character’s on-screen introduction would make or break the film’s authenticity, Leonardo DiCaprio and director Baz Luhrmann agonized over the exact execution of this literary mandate. When shooting the now-iconic reveal set to George Gershwin’s “Rhapsody in Blue,” DiCaprio didn’t just flash a charming grin; he meticulously workshopped the expression to be a multilayered performance. The resulting shot—featuring DiCaprio raising a glass amidst a backdrop of cascading fireworks—required him to perfectly balance genuine magnetic warmth with the subtle, strained micro-expressions of a man desperately projecting a self-invented, theatrical facade. The meticulously crafted moment succeeded so completely that it transcended the film itself, becoming a ubiquitous piece of modern pop culture iconography that flawlessly encapsulates the tragic illusion of the character in a single frame.

The Great Gatsby (2013), directed by Baz Luhrmann, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Tobey Maguire, Carey Mulligan, Joel Edgerton. A Midwestern aspiring writer moves to New York in the spring of 1922 and becomes drawn into the captivating, decadent world of his mysterious millionaire neighbor, bearing witness to a tragic cycle of impossible love, grand illusions, and deceit.

source_details.synopsis: The Great Gatsby is a 2013 historical romantic drama film based on the 1925 novel by F. Scott Fitzgerald. The film was co-written and directed by Baz Luhrmann and stars an ensemble cast consisting of Leonardo DiCaprio, Tobey Maguire, Carey Mulligan, Joel Edgerton, Amitabh Bachchan, Isla Fisher, Jason Clarke, and Elizabeth Debicki. Filming took place from September to December 2011 in Australia, with a $105 million net production budget. The film follows the life and times of millionaire Jay Gatsby (DiCaprio) and his neighbor Nick Carraway (Maguire), who recounts his interactions with Gatsby amid the riotous parties of the Jazz Age on Long Island in New York.
